definitions.explanation: A mechanical device that plays a tune when wound up, using a rotating cylinder with pins that pluck tuned metal teeth.

examples.english: This shop collects music boxes from around the world, and you can choose and buy one with your favorite song.

notes:
オルゴール refers exclusively to music boxes in Japanese.

ETYMOLOGY:
From Dutch "orgel" (organ). Despite the etymology, it does not mean organ — a pipe organ is ⟦パイプ→パイプ：00338_paipu⟧オルガン.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- オルゴール⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ねじ→ねじ：00307_neji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to wind up a music box
- オルゴール⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音色|ねいろ}→音色：07422_neiro⟧: the tone/sound of a music box
- オルゴール⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with a built-in music box (jewelry boxes, etc.)
- オルゴール⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧: music box tune

CULTURAL NOTE:
Music boxes are popular souvenirs and gifts in Japan. Several tourist areas have dedicated オルゴール⟦{館|かん}→館：17308_kan⟧ (music box museums/shops), notably in {小樽|おたる} (Otaru, Hokkaido) and {河口湖|かわぐちこ} (Kawaguchiko).
